requirements: Classify offline evaluator evidence with independent canaries on PowerShell 5.1 and 7
Normalize explicit call identities and usage provenance without fabricating missing telemetry
Preserve existing rules routing adapters and QA semantics with no model calls or dependency installation

design.ownership: Standalone scripts/evaluate-offline.ps1 and scripts/lib/OfflineEvaluation.ps1 own optional offline evaluation; existing live coordination remains unchanged
design.data: Bounded UTF-8 JSON input contains unique expected run IDs, structured evaluator results, globally scoped call observations, and fixture/evaluator identity/version; raw preflight rejects decoded duplicate keys and numeric lexemes other than canonical unsigned integers within the safe JSON range before host parsing; output has exact raw-byte hash
design.interfaces: CLI reads explicit input and emits JSON; optional output uses CreateNew and never overwrites input or an existing report; pure library is exercised by independent literal expected-value tests
design.states: Each expected run has exactly one terminal pass/fail/ungraded/invalid/missing/timeout/cancelled/skipped classification; usage is known, unknown or conflicted with partial totals labelled separately
design.failureHandling: Reject ambiguous numeric representations and decoded case-equivalent duplicate keys anywhere including ignored fields, bound nesting to 64 before host parsing, enforce explicit scalar/object types, and reject structural errors before output; classify declared result failures and keep incomplete evidence distinct from success
design.compatibility: Use built-in PowerShell 5.1-compatible APIs; add one auto-discovered test script; do not alter existing adapters task schemas QA failure counters generic checks manual QA or model policy
design.nonGoals: No live model/provider calls, inferred provider envelope parsers, dependency installation, rules/routing changes, automatic workflow adoption, global installation or Git publication; the unpublished v1 contract does not support decimal/exponent/negative numeric literals even in ignored fields

acceptanceMapping.acceptance: Offline evaluator and twelve independent core canaries classify all expected runs correctly on PowerShell 5.1 and 7 without model calls or dependencies
acceptanceMapping.verification: Focused tests with twelve independent literal expected-value canaries plus verifier-owned public CLI probes on both hosts

acceptanceMapping.acceptance: Usage provenance deduplicates genuine calls, preserves unknown values and detects conflicts with immutable versioned raw evidence
acceptanceMapping.verification: Independent duplicate100/distinct200/nested200/unknown/conflict controls, attribution/parent validation, raw-byte hash and version drift assertions, and input/output preservation probes

acceptanceMapping.acceptance: Existing regression suites pass on both hosts while rules routing adapters and QA semantics remain unchanged
acceptanceMapping.verification: Full scripts/test.ps1 on PowerShell 7 and 5.1; independent diff review confirms scope; final project Memory validator

newEvidence: Independent final CLI verification passes 55 cases per host after raw-lexeme and scalar/container correction; all110 raw inputs and report fingerprints are unchanged and final code hashes match
First full QA failed because runtime default TEMP denies Git config writes and atomic rename; a controlled task-owned visualization directory permits both operations without any source changes

Second full QA exposes Windows restricted junction and MSYS named-object failures plus excessive Git worktree path length; repository validator also scans retained ignored task diagnostic logs for personal paths; these are concrete execution-context causes rather than new offline evaluator defects

Prepared a clean source export of118 delivered candidate files with matching SHA256 and no task board/logs; final both-host execution will verify export/source hashes before each run and use a shorter exclusively task-owned temporary root without changing existing regression scripts

The elevated clean-export PowerShell7 full run passed all16 test scripts and repository validation with current frozen candidate hashes; its immutable check receipt will be composed with the remaining PowerShell5.1 run rather than repeating unchanged passed tests

PowerShell5.1 runner wrapper stopped before tests because @(...ConvertFrom-Json) wrapped the manifest array as one pipeline object; direct typed object-array assignment fixes only test orchestration, and both-host118-entry hash probes will verify this before the remaining full run
